chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from Yunus, the mawla of Ali, from Abu Ayoub Al-Khazzaz, who said:

I saw Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) after he had slaughtered [the sacrificial animal], he shaved [his head], then applied musk to his head, and visited the House [the Kaaba], and upon him was a shirt, and he was performing Tamattu'.
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Abu Ayoub, [narrating] similarly.
ai.seo_question: What are the ritual steps and permissible attire for a person performing Hajj al-Tamattu' according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the practical application of Tamattu' Hajj by Imam Al-Hasan (AS), emphasizing the permissibility of wearing simple clothing and using perfume after shaving the head prior to the Tawaf. It serves as a key juristic precedent for the Mu'tamir, illustrating that the state of Ihram restrictions are lifted for these specific acts once the sacrifice is made and the head is shaved, reinforcing the flexibility within Shia fiqh regarding ritual purity and adornment during the pilgrimage.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Yunus, a slave of Ali , from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz who said,

‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws after having slaughtered, shaved off hisasws head, then applied musk on hisasws head, and visited the House (Kabah), and upon himasws was a shirt, and heasws was a performer of Tumatto’.
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Abu Ayoub – approximate to it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from Yunus Mawla’ Ali from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz who has said the following: “

I saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, after slaughtering his offering and shaving applied musk to his head and visited the House wearing a shirt and he (the Imam) was for al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous).”
NOTE: Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from abu Ayyub a similar Hadith.
